name.en: Fake LTO or MMDA text: “unsettled traffic violation, settle now”

how.en: A text that claims to be from the LTO, the MMDA (no-contact apprehension) or a city police office says you have an unpaid traffic violation. It names a fine, gives a deadline of a day or less and threatens license suspension or an alarm on your record. The link leads to a fake LTMS portal that asks for your details and card. The LTO says it does not send violation notices or payment links by text.

text.en: A text says it is from the LTO, MMDA or police traffic office.
It says you have an unsettled violation and a fine.
It gives a deadline and threatens suspension of your license.
It links to a page that looks like the LTO portal.
LTO Notice: Record shows an unpaid violation (Reckless Driving) under your plate. Pay the P2,000 fine today to avoid license suspension and LTMS alarm: [link]
